facts.fact: The Central Bank of Kenya's 2024 FinAccess Household Survey puts formal financial access (an active account in own name with a formal provider, covering banks, mobile money, SACCOs and other formal providers) at 84.8 percent of adults, up from 83.7 percent in 2021.
